proof: Assume the actual canonical raw output exceeds 3364 storage units. Since 1+636+Wmax_6(636)=3361, the raw set must contain K>=637 distinct clauses.

At most c=28 are retained, so at least 609 distinct clauses are genuinely new resolvents. Select one producing cross-parent pair for each distinct new resolvent. From p*q=621 pairs this leaves at most twelve pairs outside an injective non-tautological representative set G.

Let P0 be the p-side tails whose entire q-row lies in G and Q0 the q-side tails whose entire p-column lies in G. At most twelve bad pairs can contaminate at most twelve rows and twelve columns, hence |P0|>=11 and |Q0|>=15.
The >=609 distinct new signed clauses must contain both signs of every nonpivot coordinate, because forbidding one sign on one coordinate leaves at most 2*3^5=486 signed clauses.

For each coordinate, P0 and Q0 cannot both contain that coordinate. If p0 in P0 and q0 in Q0 both contain it, their good pair fixes a common sign s. The clean row of p0 forces every Q occurrence to use s, and the clean column of q0 forces every P occurrence to use s, contradicting the required opposite sign among G outputs.

Thus the active-coordinate sets of P0 and Q0 are disjoint. Eleven distinct nonempty ternary tails require at least three active coordinates because 3^2-1=8<11; fifteen distinct nonempty tails also require at least three. With six coordinates total, the clean cores therefore split the coordinates exactly 3+3. Call the P0 side A and the Q0 side B.

Every P tail has a distinct projection onto A. Indeed, if t different P tails shared one A-projection, then pairing all of them with the |Q0|>=15 clean B-supported tails would create 15*t distinct G outputs inside one fixed A-projection fiber. That fiber has only 3^3=27 possible B-projections, so t<=floor(27/15)=1.
For any fixed A-coordinate, only 2*3^2=18 of the 27 A-projections contain that coordinate. Because all 23 P tails have distinct A-projections, at most 18 P tails contain the coordinate.

Regularity is exact: L=n*d=350 and d=50 is the minimum live-variable degree, so all seven live variables have degree 50. A nonpivot coordinate can occur in at most c=28 retained clauses, hence it occurs in at least 50-28=22 pivot-parent tails. Therefore the Q bucket contains each A-coordinate in at least 22-18=4 tails.

Q0 is supported only on B, so for every A-coordinate some exceptional Q tail contains it. Every P0 row is clean, hence that exceptional Q tail is compatible with every P0 tail. Its literal sign forbids the opposite sign throughout P0 on that coordinate.

This restriction holds independently on all three A-coordinates. Since P0 is supported on A, each coordinate then has only two allowed symbols in P0: omission or one permitted sign. There are at most 2^3-1=7 distinct nonempty such tails, contradicting |P0|>=11.
Therefore the assumed cap violation is impossible and the actual raw output of the 23x27 transition is at most 3364 storage units.
